description: This file is a shell script that performs performance tests on git repository operations, such as references, branches, tags, and commit graph checks, using various git commands and some custom test tools.

methods.name: test_perf_large_repo
methods.description: Sets up a large repository for performance testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description and commands.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance measurement with a description and command sequence.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
